name: Warsong Runner Update
summary: Across Ashenvale, Warsong Runner Update warns of mounting pressure on the Warsong Clan's border. The report alerts commanders to increasingly bold naga attacks on Horde outposts.

sections.title: Frontline Dispatches
sections.body: Across Ashenvale, Warsong scouts and runners watch the fighting and keep supply lines open. Night elf sentinels and the forest make their work dangerous, so frontier commanders need news quickly. Couriers carry dispatches to remote garrisons and to commanders such as Kadrak at the Mor'shan Rampart.

sections.title: The Naga Threat
sections.body: Horde defenders expect night elves among the trees, yet outpost sentries report bolder naga attacks. The serpentine invaders strike from waterways and ancient ruins, testing barricades and drawing defenders from forest and border patrols. A dispatch to the Mor'shan Rampart warns of these coordinated assaults from the water.

faq.q: Who is the report being sent to?
faq.answer: The report is being sent to Kadrak, an overseer at the Mor'shan Rampart between Ashenvale and the northern Barrens.

faq.q: What threats are mentioned in the update?
faq.answer: The scout reports repeated assaults on the local outpost and a growing threat from hostile naga in nearby waters.

faq.q: Why does the Horde rely on foot runners here?
faq.answer: Dense foliage, night elf marksmen, and isolated outposts make flight difficult or dangerous across parts of Ashenvale. Runners carry messages quickly and discreetly along guarded paths.
Warsong Runners are scouts, couriers, and vanguard fighters of the Warsong Clan. They guard supply lines and watch enemy movements along the forest's contested borders.

faq.q: Where are the naga attacking in Ashenvale?
faq.answer: Naga attack from strongholds in ruins along Ashenvale's shores and lakes. They ambush travelers and raid nearby camps.

faq.q: What is the outpost's purpose in this area?
faq.answer: The outpost warns of danger and anchors the defenses. It guards communication between lumber operations deep in the forest and the Barrens.

angles.text: Along the forest frontier, every soldier counts. Open communication between the Barrens and forward outposts is vital to survival.
As an orc, you know the Warsong Clan depends on its runners' grit and watchfulness to hold ground claimed under Warchief Thrall's command.
